{{Top|leg}}
A '''top tracker''', also known as a '''terrain tracer''' was a professional who was adept at tracking the movements of individuals or animals across various terrain types. A number of top trackers served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Additionally, due to the similar demands of their occupation, many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were top trackers as well.
